name: md-scrub
description: A Claude Code plugin that enforces what Claude writes in Markdown.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: For the Jev classifier, which checks Markdown against your topics. Get one at openrouter.ai/keys; checks cost a fraction of a cent per file. You need this or a TypeSafe key; md-scrub stays off until you add one.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Reaches Jev directly from TypeSafe, its maker, instead of through OpenRouter. Get one at console.typesafe.ai/keys. If both keys are set, this one is used.
